title: ever AIDA|Cold Shoulder Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This ruffle cold-shoulder chiffon bridesmaid dress is an easy win when you want something romantic, comfortable, and photo-friendly. The layered ruffle neckline adds softness and balances the upper body, while the cold-shoulder sleeves give light arm coverage without feeling restrictive, great if you¡¯re not into fully strapless styles. A defined waist and flowing A-line, floor-length skirt skim over the midsection and hips for a flattering, non-clingy fit. It¡¯s made for garden weddings, beach ceremonies, outdoor summer receptions, and any bridal party look that needs effortless movement from aisle walk to dance floor.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
